name: Job Interviews
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on job interviews — practice these key phrases out loud:
Could you tell me a bit about yourself?
What would you say is your greatest strength?
Why are you interested in this position?
Do you have any questions for us?
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
